One prompt

$ cargo run --release -p orcacode -- -p "Summarize the test failures"
$ cargo run --release -p orcacode -- --json -p "List changed files"
$ cargo run --release -p orcacode -- --plan -p "Propose a migration plan"

-p / --prompt supplies the request. Add --json to emit NDJSON harness events to stdout for a program to consume.

Automation and approvals

Headless runs still use approval policy. Add --auto-approve to allow shell, write, and edit calls without prompting; --yolo implies it. Use --plan when the job should inspect and propose only.

SCRIPTING TIP

Pass --workspace explicitly in automation rather than relying on the caller’s current directory. Add --no-session for ephemeral jobs that should not write session history.
